correctness.rationale: The frozen cutoff and finite matrices are mathematically correct; the reason for repair is coverage, not a failed identity. The repaired proof uses the zero mode and R(-z)=1-z/(1+z/2+z^2/12) to obtain I-12L^+/h+O(h^-2) at each fixed n. Summing the path resistance identity using the zero row sums of L^+ gives L^+_{01}=(n-1)(2n-7)/(6n). At distance seven only the unique length-seven walk contributes in the first nonzero Taylor term and its coefficient is -1/1728. An independent exact SymPy reconstruction produced the four-node threshold and the eight-node matrix; the latter has minimum 596772/61423369 only at (3,4) and (4,3) in zero-based indexing. The repaired standard-library integer check was replayed successfully with `python3 /workspace/repairs/3/artifacts/check_witness.py`; it verifies BN=61423369A, symmetry and every row sum. The uploaded checker was inspected, not run. Continuous dependence in h turns the exact witness into an open interval, not a classification of its endpoints.

value.rationale: Reversibility and strictly positive intermediate entries are substantive restrictions absent from the absorbing example. The smallest possible path dimension gives a natural benchmark; the exact witness rules out a single downward or upward timestep threshold even in this simple conservative heat model, and the resistance-based coefficient shows that the large-step obstruction is not an accident of the witness. Covered small-path benchmarks and the known Taylor coefficient are not counted toward the value of the repair.
